title: Write translation notes
subtitle: Separate what the Greek says from an interpretive inference.
overview: A useful reading note has three layers: observed form, syntactic relation, and provisional English. Interpretation follows these observations rather than replacing them.
Keep ambiguities visible. A translation can be readable while a note records another grammatically possible relationship.

sections.title: Three layers
rows: State how it attaches or advances the paragraph.
Give English that reflects the observed relation.

items.grc: ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν.
items.en: Form: genitive phrase; note: context must establish its precise relationship.

items.grc: δικαιωθέντες οὖν ἐκ πίστεως εἰρήνην ἔχομεν.
items.en: Form: aorist passive participle; relation: grounds the following claim.
